sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up middle-aged officer, shoulders and head angled slightly toward screen-right with eyes toward the viewer; very high receding/bald crown with thin short reddish-brown hair around sides and back, clear dark brows and a thick brown moustache on the upper lip only. Keep bare smooth cheeks/jaw/chin with no beard and preserve the gentle serious expression. No hat or eyewear. Gray-olive service coat with wide notched lapels, vivid red collar patches bearing small gold embroidered shapes, cream closed shirt and dark muted green tie. Maintain the full pale cream-gray painted rectangular backing and the original light and crop; compact broad mascot head, short neck fitted into the buttoned shirt and matching coat opening.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up almost front-facing officer wearing a soft burgundy/maroon beret drooping toward screen-left and a small gold badge on the raised screen-right portion. Short brown hair visible under the beret and dark brows, mild closed-mouth expression, pale eyes. Cheeks/jaw/chin show no clearly resolved beard; the narrow dark upper-lip edge is too small/soft to establish a definite fine moustache, so preserve subtle source mouth shading without inventing thick facial hair. Gray-green/khaki service jacket with broad folded lapels, shoulder tabs, a tiny gold rectangular badge on screen-right breast, gray-green buttoned shirt and muted khaki tie. Preserve exact pose, cap slope, lighting and complete pale gray-cream painted background; adapt collar to a short broad mascot neck. Alpha253..255 is only a numeric observation, with no visible cutout.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Direct front-facing chest-up officer with blue eyes, a calm firm closed mouth, short neatly combed brown hair visible below the cap, clear dark brows and smooth bare upper lip, cheeks and chin; no moustache or beard. Broad olive peaked cap with bright red band, brown leather chin strap, olive visor and a tall central gold crown-like badge. Olive jacket with prominent long red collar patches edged/decorated in gold, shoulder tabs and a pale green closed shirt with darker green tie; retain the visible gold cord/trim on screen-left shoulder. Keep source crop, cream-gray complete painted background and lighting, with compact mascot head and short broad neck fitted into the same closed collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Nearly front-facing chest-up clean-shaven officer with head slightly tilted toward screen-right and a restrained closed-mouth smile; short reddish-brown side hair beneath a khaki peaked cap, brown brows and blue-gray eyes. Keep smooth bare upper lip, cheeks/jaw/chin with no moustache or beard. Cap has a brown leather band/strap and a small gold/silver wreath-like central badge whose tiny internal figure cannot be resolved. Olive-khaki military tunic with broad folded collar, fine lighter edge trim, central gold throat/front buttons and buttoned shoulder straps; no added tie or medals. Preserve lighting, shoulders, crop and full pale gray painted backing; fit the tunic naturally to a short broad yellow mascot neck.
